description: The account's images, models and audio files that nothing uses — no project, no entity template, no other user's project — with each one's size and date, biggest first, and the total. The same report as the R3 app's Settings → Storage, by the same rules the deletes use. A model lists the images only it uses, an HDR / EXR image its preview image: they go with it. A texture set nothing uses is one item (kind textureSet) with its maps under it; a map of a set is never listed on its own. Blender (.blend) files are not part of it: they are the user's to keep or delete, listed by r3_blender_list. Pass `kind` to see one kind, `limit` for more rows (the totals always cover everything). It only reads; r3_asset_delete deletes an item by its kind and id (a plan, then a confirm), for what the user asked to remove. The scan can take several seconds.

kind.description: Only this kind: image, model, audio or textureSet.

limit.description: How many items to list (default 50, at most 200).

name: r3_assets_unused

answer.description: This answer in words: what was done, what R3 measured, decided or refused, and what to do next. The same text as the result's text block. Read it: the fields beside it are the data, this is the guidance.

title: List unused images, models and audio
